title: DeadLetter
description:
One message the Queue gave up on after 3 retries, from `GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/dead-letters`
(an array of these), and the answer to a redrive.

at.description: When it was dead-lettered, a wall time.

error.description: The last delivery error, as a reason code such as `Kitchen answered 503`.

id.description: The event's ULID: the key a redrive sends it again with.
